tips.text: Check your clan's Energy Lab before farming anything; an established clan has probably researched it already.
Expect to do the full research yourself, Amprex prerequisite included, if you are solo or in a dead clan.
Buy several Fieldron blueprints and run the 12-hour crafts at the same time instead of one after another.
Expect the grumbling to be about single-use dojo blueprints and 12-hour Fieldron crafts, not the weapon.
